profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, trading under the ticker META. Its developer site presents AI models and tools for building, including Muse Spark, which the company describes as accessible through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The site says Muse Spark is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It also offers search grounding, which gives a model live access to the web through a single tool added to a request, and notes that an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client can be pointed at the Meta Model API. The company's tracked product is Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

Meta's held record includes four lawsuits: State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. Its law exposure record lists California with a count of 281. The company's most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting 200966000000 USD.

A number of MCP servers in the record relate to Meta's advertising and AI services, including ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads MCP server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, and co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, described as Facebook and Meta Ads automation with AI for analyzing performance, testing creatives, and optimizing spend. com.adbloop/meta-ads is described as bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders. Other listed servers include ai.fastmetal/fastmetal for running and comparing LLMs, ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research over a corpus of 12,400 papers, ai.lumeta/lumeta, ai.metabind/banking-assistant, ai.metabind/docs, ai.primeta/primeta, and app.metadock/metadock.
